name: Cyber Security
overview: Cyber Security Engineering is a dynamic and crucial field that intersects cutting-edge technology with the ever-evolving landscape of digital threats and vulnerabilities. The discipline involves designing protective measures to detect, prevent, and mitigate cyberattacks while balancing technological innovation with ethical responsibilities regarding data security and privacy.

topJobs.description: Monitor networks to detect breaches and enact security protocols.
Orchestrate simulated attacks to expose system vulnerabilities.
Monitor security alerts in real-time for threat mitigation.
Design and implement impregnable systems and networks.

institutesInternational: University of Maryland, College Park, USA
careerLadder: Excel in high school math, computer science, and statistics
Pursue Bachelor's degree (B.Tech/B.Sc) in Cybersecurity or Computer Science
Complete internships, research, and coding competitions
Consider GRE or GATE examinations for global university admission
Continue lifelong learning and skill development
